privacy.text9: Last updated: June 10, 2026. Your privacy is vitally important to us. Learn how we collect and process your personal data.
privacy.text11: We collect personal information that you provide directly when registering with Miiles, such as your name, email address, and professional or business profile details.
privacy.text12: We also collect information automatically through your use of the Platform. This includes technical data about your device, your IP address, the type of browser you use, and detailed information about your interactions with the canvas and our interactive AI tools.
privacy.text13: We use your personal information to operate, maintain, and improve the Service's tools. This includes personalizing your digital canvas, synchronizing real-time collaboration with your team's avatars, and processing your requests using our artificial intelligence models.
privacy.text14: We also use your email address to send important technical notifications, billing notices, or relevant platform information about brand collaboration opportunities. You may opt out of promotional emails at any time.
privacy.text15: Miiles does not sell your personal data to third parties under any circumstances. We share information with trusted service providers that help us operate the platform (such as databases, authentication integrators, and payment gateways), always under strict confidentiality terms.
privacy.text16: Additionally, if you voluntarily participate in brand collaboration campaigns or public portfolios, the information you choose to share on that profile will be visible to associated brands registered with Miiles.
privacy.text17: The security of your information is extremely important. We implement robust technical and organizational measures, such as SSL/TLS data encryption protocols during transmission and secure server storage, to protect your information from unauthorized access, alteration, or destruction.
privacy.text18: Despite our efforts, please remember that no method of internet transmission or electronic storage is completely infallible. We therefore recommend always protecting your passwords and access credentials.
privacy.text19: Depending on your geographical location, you may have certain rights over your personal data under data protection regulations (such as the GDPR or equivalent laws). These rights include requesting access to your personal data, correction of errors, or complete deletion of your records from our database.
privacy.text20: If you wish to exercise any of your rights or request account closure and complete removal of your personal data, you can do so directly in your account's profile section or contact us at our legal support email address.
